payload.core_mechanism_summary: Scans grid rows/columns, accumulates consecutive '.' run lengths horizontally and vertically; adds (length-k+1) for each run of length >= k. For k=1, vertical runs omitted to avoid double-counting.
payload.rationale: The algorithm directly counts k-windows via run-length formulas, not enumeration. None of the provided subtypes accurately describe this scanning method; search_permutation_enumeration is the least irrelevant among them.
